data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 神社初诣振袖和服的端庄回眸·「新年快乐，折木同学」
data.description: 【荒楠神社红鸟居前·初雪初诣】新年参拜的清晨。爱瑠身穿淡紫色印花高档振袖和服，宽大的织锦腰带勾勒出端庄身段，黑发挽成典雅发髻并插着精致花簪。在朱红鸟居与白雪之间，她双手交叠于腹前微微回眸，尽显豪农名门千金的贵气与娇羞。
data.location: 古神社红鸟居与雪景石阶前
data.action: 身着振袖和服双手叠腹回眸微躬，花簪微晃，紫眸含笑祝福
data.lighting: 初雪石阶反光与神社晨曦相映
data.camera: medium full shot, furisode kimono, torii gate, snow falling
data.promptProse: Eru Chitanda stands gracefully before the snow-dusted red torii gate of the shrine on New Year's Day, wearing a magnificent lavender silk furisode kimono with floral crest patterns and a golden obi sash. Her raven hair is swept up into a traditional noble chignon secured by a flowering kanzashi hairpin. She rests her hands neatly over her front sash, looking back over her shoulder with a shy, radiant New Year's greeting as gentle snowflakes drift through the winter air.
